value.rationale: The unique symmetric cubic graph on sixteen vertices is a canonical next incidence configuration after the Fano 7-point example. Its exactly computed 69/2/1 phase-preimage spectrum and nine attraction-basin strata distinguish its majority dynamics from related Heawood and Desargues examples. The sharp three-update cutoff and unequal attraction to consensus versus primitive oscillations are natural full invariants of this fixed network, not arbitrary induced sub-slices; findings motivate comparison of majority basin geometry across finite incidence graphs.
